final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrower framing is analytically better, but it still leaves the key compliance predicate unmet on the evidence available to this role. Under the policy text, rollout controls can mitigate only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable. The current record, as summarized, shows neither. A caveated position could support compliant_with_caveats only if the caveat described a bounded residual issue after the required predicate was satisfied. Here, the missing disclosure evidence or approved risk acceptance is itself the unresolved predicate, so the issue remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the final model-card disclosure text was actually included.
No admissible evidence shows the required disclosure was reviewed or approved under policy.
The weak enterprise refund-workflow segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The unsigned, incomplete risk-acceptance draft does not satisfy the reviewed risk-acceptance predicate.
Rollout controls, rollback, and monitoring do not cure the disclosure condition while the affected segment remains exposed.
